description:
In spring, as cherry blossoms drift in the air, Chan-Young, a 20-year-old repeat student, has his earphones hooked to the zipper of a 27-year-old postal clerk, Mi-Sun. 

In summer, as trees offer shade, a charming male doctor, Jun-Sung, plays cupid to Min-Hee and Gan-Gi, a pair of seemingly longtime lovers. 

In autumn, as red maple leaves decorate the blue sky, Gyeong-Tae, Jeong-Mi's ex-boyfriend, a web comic writer, suddenly appears at her doorstep. He's back. 

In winter, as heavy snow blankets the earth, Soo-Heon, the chef of Gom Restaurant, meets a young woman in a rural guesthouse in Gangwon-do during a snowy day... 

(Source: WeComics)
